title: Open cloze: security rules
instructions: Escribí UNA palabra gramatical en cada hueco.
text: You [1] share your password with anyone: it is a company rule. If you forget it, you can ask IT to reset it, but IT will never ask you [2] it. All employees have [3] change their passwords every ninety days. Your files [4] backed up automatically every night, so you don't [5] to save copies yourself.

items.e: Está prohibido → mustn't.
ask (someone) FOR something.
have TO + verbo base.
Your files are backed up: pasiva de presente simple.

title: Open cloze: the website incident
instructions: Escribí UNA palabra gramatical en cada hueco.
text: The website was down for an hour last night. The server [1] have crashed because of a memory problem, but nobody is sure. The team should [2] checked the logs earlier. The problem [3] discovered by a customer, not by our monitoring system. By tomorrow, all the data [4] have been restored, and the servers [5] being monitored more carefully.

items.e: 'nobody is sure' → posibilidad pasada: might/may/could have crashed.
should HAVE + participio (crítica).
Past Simple pasivo: was discovered.
By tomorrow → Future Perfect pasivo: will have been restored.
are being monitored (Continuous pasivo).

title: Multiple choice cloze: the Monday crash
instructions: Elegí la opción correcta para cada hueco.
text: The application crashed on Monday. We [1] tested it more carefully before the release, but we did not have time. The developer [2] have known about the bug, because she wrote a comment about it in the code. She [3] told the manager, but she didn't. Now the issue [4] by a specialist team. title: The security audit
instructions: Leé el texto y elegí la respuesta correcta para cada pregunta.
text:
Last week, an external company reviewed the security of Nova Systems, a software company with three hundred employees. The audit lasted five days, and the results were presented on Friday.
According to the report, the technical part of the system is well protected. All data is stored in encrypted servers, and every change is recorded automatically. However, the auditors found several problems with human behaviour. Some employees share passwords with colleagues, and others use the same password for all their accounts. "This mustn't happen," the head auditor explained. "One stolen password can open the door to the whole company."
The company has reacted quickly. New rules are being prepared, and a training course will be offered to everyone. Employees who already know the basics don't have to attend, but they should read the new guide. The company's director admitted that the audit should have been done years ago. "We were lucky nothing serious happened," she said. "It could have been a disaster."
The changes will have been completed by the end of the year, and a second audit is planned for next spring.

items.q: What did the audit find about the technical system?
items.e: 'the technical part of the system is well protected'.

items.q: What problem did the auditors find?
items.e: 'share passwords ... use the same password for all their accounts'.

items.q: Who doesn't have to attend the training course?
o: Employees who already know the basics
items.a: Employees who already know the basics
items.e: 'Employees who already know the basics don't have to attend'.

items.q: What does the director say about the audit?
o: It should have been done earlier
items.a: It should have been done earlier
items.e: 'the audit should have been done years ago'.

items.q: What is planned for next spring?
items.e: 'a second audit is planned for next spring'.

title: Programmers and AI tools
instructions: Leé el texto y elegí la respuesta correcta.
text: Many people believe that artificial intelligence will soon be able to write all software, but experienced programmers are not convinced. AI tools can generate code quickly, and they are already being used by thousands of developers. However, the code they produce must be reviewed carefully, because it may contain errors that are difficult to notice. Some companies have already suffered problems that could have been avoided if the code had been checked by a human. For this reason, many experts argue that programmers should learn to work with these tools rather than fear them. A developer who can explain what a piece of code does, and why it might fail, is unlikely to be replaced.

items.q: Why must code produced by AI be reviewed?
o: It may contain errors that are hard to notice
It cannot be read by humans
items.a: It may contain errors that are hard to notice
items.e: 'it may contain errors that are difficult to notice'.

o: Programmers should learn to work with AI tools
items.a: Programmers should learn to work with AI tools
items.e: 'programmers should learn to work with these tools rather than fear them'.
